caption_text: Cold-start AUC (P1) of Jev against the best deep KT and the best LLM-based KT baseline with N training learners (mean over 5 seeds). Without training data, Jev0-shot is above LLM-based KT on all seven datasets and above deep KT trained on 8 learners on average; JevKT stays ahead of deep KT up to N=64 on average. Wins: datasets on which Jev beats every baseline in its block. †Best of 28 pyKT models, selected on test. ‡LOKT, the strongest LLM-based KT baseline. ∘N=0 value repeated (no answer options). §Reported by LLM-KT on its own split; not ranked. All models: Appendix . Best in bold, second best underlined.
